info.name: Vault Key Management Kms Hsm Cluster API
Lists all HSM cluster resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description:
The value of the `opc-next-page` response header
from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. You can specify only one sort order. The default
order for `TIMECREATED` is descending. The default order for `DISPLAYNAME`
is ascending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

items.docs:
Lists all HSM cluster resources contained within the specified compartment.

As a provisioning operation, this call is subject to a Key Management limit that applies to
the total number of requests across all provisioning read operations. Key Management might
throttle this call to reject an otherwise valid request when the total rate of provisioning
read operations exceeds 10 requests per second for a given tenancy.

info.name: Updates the properties of a HSM Cluster resource.

params.name: hsmClusterId
params.description: The OCID of the HSM Cluster. This is a unique identifier assigned to each hsmCluster.

items.docs:
Modifies properties of an HSM cluster resource, including `displayName`, `freeformTags` and `definedTags`.

As a provisioning operation, this call is subject to a Key Management limit that applies to
the total number of requests across all provisioning write operations. Key Management might
throttle this call to reject an otherwise valid request when the total rate of provisioning
write operations exceeds 10 requests per second for a given tenancy.

items.docs: Cancels deletion of specified HSM Cluster, restores it and associated HSM partitions to pre-deletion states.

info.name: Schedules the deletion of a HSM Cluster resource.

params.name: hsmClusterId
params.description: The OCID of the HSM Cluster. This is a unique identifier assigned to each hsmCluster.

items.docs:
Schedules HSM cluster for deletion, update its lifecycle state to 'PENDING_DELETION' 
and deletes it after the retention period.
